in_sanskrit.name: अंकन्ध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अंक (ank) - number, ध (dh) - rooted; this name is derived from अंकन्धन (ankadhan) meaning root of a number, which refers to a large body of water or a tank.

in_hindi.name: तांक
in_hindi.long_meaning: तां (tank) - container, क (k) - full, कूलद्रेका (kooladreka) - cooler; this name refers to a large container filled with water to keep it cool.

in_tamil.name: தங்க
in_tamil.long_meaning: தங் (tank) - container, க (k) - full; this name refers to a large container filled with water, which is either used to irrigate the land or as a source of drinking water.

in_telugu.name: తెంక
in_telugu.long_meaning: తెం (tank) - large, క (k) - filled; this name is derived from 'బెజేజేశ్వర దేశపూజోట్టేదు' (Bhejajeshwara deshopujottu) meaning filled with the god Bhejajeshwara's grace.

in_marathi.name: Tank
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Container, Storage Vessel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Tank is a name for a large body of water used for various purposes like irrigation, drinking and bathing. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tanka', meaning 'to fill'. In English, it is a name given to a large, watertight container used for storing liquids. This name symbolizes strength, courage, protection and the ability to hold and nurture.
